workflow: Android APK probe, native fidelity CI and 15-minute queue handoff

policy.completion_requires: Merged source, passing tests, and recorded evidence; UI-only or stub implementations do not count.
policy.task_claims: When starting a task mark in_progress; use base commit/PR review to avoid duplicated edits.
policy.handoff: On merge/main push, CI completion or 15-minute scheduled check, surface eligible tasks in the GitHub Actions summary. When Issues are enabled, also create deduplicated issues. Only a connected coding agent may implement and validate code; no automatic completion without acceptance evidence.

progress.basis: Merged PR #5 synthetic XP Marshal fidelity gate (27/27 native tests), PR #6 ZIP IPC framing (five tests + Android APK), PR #7 save error propagation (two tests + Android APK), and PR #9 bounded ZIP export (29/29 native tests + Android APK). Each has passing CI evidence; PR #9 prevents oversized compressed export from exhausting app-private storage. Real Pokémon Essentials v21.1 import/edit/export/reopen, Android SAF destination and on-device graphics/gestures remain unverified; release licensing is unresolved. Estimated overall completion 19% -> 20%, a conservative increase for tested native export robustness only. Draft PR #12 proposes Android SAF streaming export with readback; 31 native tests and ARM64 APK compile passed, but it remains unmerged pending physical-device/provider and real-project verification, so the completion estimate remains 20%. PR #14 is now merged with 31/31 native tests and Android ARM64 APK, but no genuine project/device validation; estimated total remains 20%. Independent ASM-014 draft PR #15 removes 13 inherited lint errors (41 to 28 in CI); Android CI pending and no Android fidelity gate closed. PR #15 merged and CI passed, improving inherited lint without closing ASM-014. PRs #16 and #17 merged after 33/33 native archive tests, four Node editor preflight tests, and both TypeScript/Android ARM64 CI suites passed. This improves import portability and failure handling; genuine v21.1/device acceptance remains pending. Conservative total completion 20% -> 21% for these tested merged improvements. Watchdog handoff regression after PR #15 repaired in merged PR #18 (b1f152b0475b1ddcb4830b5d63f6d47c337e4701), with targeted Node handoff test passing in the frontend job of run 40869584884; main watchdog revalidation pending. No additional project-completion credit for workflow-only changes. Draft PR #20 proposes failed-import private-storage cleanup; CI pending, so no further increase beyond 21%.
